title: Essential: k expression
description: Essential Criteria: The student must state that k = GM/(4π²) or an algebraically equivalent form.

title: Essential: Earth mass expression
description: Essential Criteria: The student must derive the expression M_earth = (4π²r₁³)/(GT₁²) from Kepler's law and gravitational force.

title: Essential: Numerical mass value
description: Essential Criteria: The student must calculate and state a numerical mass for Earth of approximately 6 × 10²⁴ kg (to one significant figure).

title: Important: Force balance setup
description: Important Criteria: The solution must equate gravitational force (GMm/r²) to centripetal force (mω²r or mv²/r) for the circular orbit.

title: Important: Angular velocity substitution
description: Important Criteria: The solution must correctly substitute ω = 2π/T to eliminate angular velocity in favor of the orbital period.

title: Optional: Unit consistency check
description: Optional Criteria: The student may verify the units of the derived expressions (k and M_earth) are dimensionally correct.

title: Pitfall: Incorrect exponent or factor
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the final expressions have incorrect exponents (e.g., r² instead of r³) or missing factors like 4π².

title: Pitfall: Calculation error
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize significant arithmetic or power-of-ten errors in the numerical estimation of Earth's mass.
